nodes.label: Soft Delete Strategy
nodes.rationale: Allows data recovery on business-critical tables while pg_cron handles permanent deletion after 30 days

nodes.label: Timezone Management
nodes.rationale: All timestamps stored in UTC; user preferences stored separately; conversion done via date-fns-tz at display layer

nodes.label: File Management (Hybrid)
nodes.rationale: Better-Auth tables use simple string fields; business tables use centralized files table with polymorphic references for referential integrity

nodes.label: Crew Scheduling
nodes.rationale: Uses schedule_assignments junction table so dispatcher can reschedule entire crew by updating a single schedule record

nodes.label: Variance Reporting
nodes.rationale: Time entries optionally link to schedule_id to compare Planned vs. Actual hours

nodes.label: Index Strategy
nodes.rationale: Composite indexes starting with org_id for tenant isolation; specialized indexes for dashboard, calendar, and notification queries
